item_name: Military Zipper First Aid Kit Contents
item_short_desc: Rothco's Military Zipper First Aid Kit Contents features 15 essential first aid items.
description: Rothco's Military Zipper First Aid Kit Contents features 15 essential first aid items. Contents of this military first aid kit include a 2" Steripad, an Adhesive Tape Roll, 4 Bandages, a 2" Conforming Bandage, 2 Alcohol Prep Pads, 2 BZK Towelettes, 1 Small Sugar Pack, 1 Soap Bar, 1 Package of Aspirin, and Instructions. These are the same contents used in Rothco's Military Zipper First Aid Kit (8318 & 8328)
